abstract: Leslie S. Babonis is an Assistant Professor at the Department of Ecology & Evolutionary Biology at Cornell University, USA. Her research focuses on understanding novelty and how new traits arise at the cellular level. We spoke with Leslie over Teams about her journey to becoming a group leader, her switch from comparative physiology to evolutionary developmental biology, her time as a mayor and how her willingness to have conversations with people from different backgrounds has helped her find her niche.
